**KubeJS blocks and connected textures from modpacks.** Reading an instance (**Use** in the Blocks panel, or **Instance…**) now also reads the blocks its KubeJS scripts make, listed as a mod named KubeJS: the blocks its startup scripts register, with the names, shapes and textures the scripts give them, and the states, models and textures written in its `kubejs/assets` folder; a resource pack left as a folder, given to **Add mods…**, reads too. Connected textures made for Fusion or OptiFine (CTM, read by Continuity too) show as in the game: each block shows one tile at its real size in the Blocks panel (Fusion's sheets were drawn whole on each block, shrunk eight times), and in the True Colour view each top shows the tiles its neighbours give it. Thanks to nicolas-vinc, who wrote the reading of KubeJS's folder and of Fusion's sheets.
